summary: The PR addresses the issue of Pylint not respecting ignore settings in recursive mode by adding a helper function to check if a file is ignored. The change is well-integrated and passes all tests.

issues.description: The method `_is_ignored_file` could be moved to a more appropriate module if there are other places where this functionality might be reused.
The addition of the `_is_ignored_file` function could benefit from a docstring explaining its purpose and parameters.
